title: 4BR Rosemary Beach Cottage Just Steps from Coquina Pool
meta_description: Stay in this 4BR, 4BA Rosemary Beach cottage steps away from Coquina Pool and two minutes from the beach, with private beach access. Sleeps 13.
description_expanded: DescriptionWhat Guests Love• 3,488 square feet• Right next to the Coquina Pool and a 2-minute walk to the beach• New 4k HDTV, Apple TV, Sonos Sound System, Logitech Elite All-in-one Remote.• Two car carport for parking• 4 Free Beach Cruiser Bikes• Access to all 4 Rosemary Beach Private Community pools• Spacious porch facing the boardwalk that leads to the beachGates Cottage is a beautiful Rosemary Beach Cottage steps away from the iconic Coquina Pool and only a two-minute walk to the beach. The property is also located within a short walk to both the Eastern Green Park and the Playground Park. This home is the perfect choice for an excellent family beach getaway!This coastal getaway features three spacious levels of living space. Gather family members and friends in the open dining space with seating up to 6 and more! The large windows in the naturally lit living room foster a peaceful relationship between the natural surroundings and interior spaces.Enjoy warm breezes and summer cocktails on the front porch with family and friends or follow the boardwalk and escape to the emerald waters of the Gulf of Mexico.HOME LAYOUT: (Sleeps 13)1st Floor• Full Bathroom with a standup shower and single vanity• Washer and Dryer laundry room• Spacious kitchen with stainless steel appliances and a prep island• Large Dining area with round dining room table with booth seating and chairs with enough seating for 6 or more guests• Bench seating area wrapping the span of the living room• Access to the front porch with charming patio furniture and tables2nd Floor• Bedroom 1: Master King Suite with flat-screen TV and access to the private second-floor balcony. Beautifully decorated full Master bathroom with gorgeous double vanities, stand-up shower, walk-in closet, and changing room.• Bedroom 2: 1 full bed and 2 twin beds. Vanity room and closet attached to Jack & Jill Full bath with a shower/tub combo.• Bedroom 3: Double Bunk Bed Room (4 Twin Beds) with a touch reading light for each bed. A vanity room and closet that is also attached to the Jack & Jill Full Bathroom.3RD Floor• Bedroom 4: Queen Bedroom with attached full bathroom w/ standing shower and linen closet. • Reading, Card & Board Game Playing nook at the top of the 3rd-floor landing • Exciting entertainment area with leveled sleeping that is a childhood favorite!STR-022922TDT-022922
